Deleting a connection stops any cross-cluster search operations on the destination domain.
You can perform the following procedure on either the source or destination domain to remove the
connection. After you remove the connection, it remains visible with a status of Deleted for 15
days.
You can't delete a domain with active cross-cluster connections. To delete a domain, ﬁrst remove
all incoming and outgoing connections from that domain. This ensures you take into account the
cross-cluster domain users before deleting the domain.
To delete a connection
1.
Sign in to the Amazon OpenSearch Service console at https://console.aws.amazon.com/aos/
home.
2.
In the left navigation, choose Domains.
Deleting a connection
1674
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
3.
Choose the name of a domain to delete, and then choose the Connections tab.
4.
Select the name of a connection to delete.
5.
Choose Delete, and then conﬁrm the deletion.
